evals.name: approve-before-launch
evals.prompt: Work acme/widgets issues 42 and 43 at the same time, and keep watch over both for me.
evals.expected_output: Joins as the overseer root, reads both issues, maps them to the project, and asks the user to approve starting them before launching any ticket thread.
expectations: Joins the workflow as the overseer root
Asks the user to approve starting the issues
Launches no ticket thread before approval

42.title: Add a --quiet flag to the widget CLI
42.body: The CLI prints progress for every widget it builds. Add a --quiet flag that suppresses the progress output, document it in the README, and cover it with a test.

43.title: Widget names should be trimmed
43.body: widget(' a ') returns 'widget  a '. Trim the name first.
